cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-describe-help
cases.why: red: a --help flag on a jj write verb only prints help; jj 0.45.1 rc=0, op log 5->5, repo tree unchanged with a dirty working copy; 1f7f995 flags jj:describe

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-st-h
cases.why: red: -h on a snapshotting jj read prints help and loads no workspace; jj 0.45.1 rc=0, op log 5->5, tree unchanged (plain `jj st` then snapshots 5->6); 1f7f995 flags jj:st

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-git-push-help
cases.why: red: help for jj git push contacts no remote and writes nothing; jj 0.45.1 rc=0, op log 5->5, tree unchanged; 1f7f995 flags jj:git

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-help-flag-describe
cases.why: red: a top-level --help before the subcommand prints jj help; jj 0.45.1 rc=0, op log 5->5, tree unchanged; 1f7f995 skips the flag and flags jj:describe

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-describe-m-x-help
cases.why: red: --help after a complete -m value is still a flag; jj 0.45.1 prints describe help, rc=0, op log 5->5, description unchanged; 1f7f995 flags jj:describe

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-describe-m-help-parse-error
cases.why: red, contradicts the item premise: clap does not take a separate --help as the -m value; jj 0.45.1 rc=2 'a value is required for --message', op log 6->6, tree unchanged; 1f7f995 flags jj:describe

cases.name: H-HelpBash-git-commit-help
cases.why: red: git turns `git commit --help` into `git help commit` (man page); git 2.56.0 rc=0, HEAD 1ed5f67 kept, status/stash and .git tree unchanged with staged changes; 1f7f995 flags git:commit

cases.name: H-HelpBash-git-commit-h
cases.why: red: -h prints commit usage; git 2.56.0 rc=0, HEAD 1ed5f67 kept, status/stash and .git tree unchanged with staged changes; 1f7f995 flags git:commit

cases.name: H-HelpBash-git-help-flag-commit
cases.why: red: `git --help commit` runs `git help commit` (man page); git 2.56.0 rc=0, HEAD and .git tree unchanged; 1f7f995 skips the flag and flags git:commit

cases.name: H-HelpBash-git-stash-h
cases.why: red: -h prints stash usage and stashes nothing; git 2.56.0 rc=0, stash list 0->0, tree unchanged (plain `git stash` 0->1); 1f7f995 flags git:stash

cases.name: H-HelpBash-git-commit-m-x-help
cases.why: red: a later --help still stops git commit at option parsing (usage); git 2.56.0 rc=0, HEAD and .git tree unchanged with staged changes; 1f7f995 flags git:commit

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-help-commit
cases.why: control: the jj help verb is already exempt (JJ_NO_SNAPSHOT); jj 0.45.1 rc=0, op log 5->5, tree unchanged; clean at both revisions

cases.name: H-HelpBash-git-help-push
cases.why: control: help is not a git write verb; git 2.56.0 rc=0 (man page), HEAD and .git tree unchanged; clean at both revisions

cases.name: H-HelpBash-git-commit-m-h
cases.why: write negative: git takes the separate -h as the -m value and commits; git 2.56.0 rc=0, HEAD 1ed5f67->6ea09cf, subject '-h'; must stay vcs_write

cases.name: H-HelpBash-git-commit-m-help
cases.why: write negative: git takes the separate --help as the -m value and commits; git 2.56.0 rc=0, HEAD 6ea09cf->9f2a946, subject '--help'; must stay vcs_write

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-help-then-describe
cases.why: write negative: a help segment then a real describe; jj 0.45.1 op log 6->8, description ''->'x'; exactly one jj:describe row (1f7f995 keeps only the help segment's row, deduped)

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-st-h-then-describe
cases.why: red write negative: help on another verb, then a real describe; jj 0.45.1 op log 8->10, description 'x'->'y'; one jj:describe row and no jj:st row (1f7f995 adds jj:st)

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-describe-message-eq-help
cases.why: write negative: an attached value is the option value; jj 0.45.1 rc=0, op log 16->18, description 'reset-2'->'--help'; must stay vcs_write

cases.name: H-HelpBash-jj-describe-dashdash-help
cases.why: write negative: after -- the token is a revset, not a flag; jj 0.45.1 snapshots the dirty working copy (op log 10->11), then rc=1 revset parse error; must stay vcs_write
